scripts.host: pnpm run make && pnpm publish --access public
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && (cd deck/deck && pnpm install) && (cd deck/mill && pnpm install) && (cd deck/base && pnpm install) && (cd deck/flow && pnpm install --ignore-workspace)
scripts.make:load: pnpm run make:port && pnpm exec tsx task/make-load.ts
scripts.make:line:steps: pnpm run make:port && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/host/port/code/line/base-run.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/line.js --metafile=.base/@term/code/line-meta.json --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/code/hook-dispatch.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/dock.mjs --metafile=.base/@term/code/dock-meta.json &&pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/host/port/code/work/need/version-dispatch.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/need.mjs --metafile=.base/@term/code/need-meta.json &&pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/host/port/code/work/need/choice-report.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/need-hand.mjs --metafile=.base/@term/code/need-hand-meta.json &&pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/host/port/code/work/workers/file-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/build-worker.mjs --metafile=.base/@term/code/build-worker-meta.json &&pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/host/port/code/work/workers/unit-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --outfile=host/separate-worker.mjs --metafile=.base/@term/code/separate-worker-meta.json &&pnpm exec tsx task/line-imports.ts
